auth_method.title: Choose Authentication Help
auth_method.description:
**Wizard (Recommended)**: Guided step-by-step process with clear instructions to extract credentials from your browser.

**Manual**: Condensed instructions for users already familiar with browser developer tools.

wizard_login.title: Wizard: One-Click Extraction

user.description: Select your Account Type. Most users will need to select Google Account. Field Test is only available for selected testers in the Google Field Test program.

account_link.title: Connect Your Nest Account
account_link.description:
Follow these steps to get your credentials:

1. Open an **Incognito/Private** browser window
2. Enable **third-party cookies** in browser settings
3. Go to [home.nest.com](https://home.nest.com) and sign in with Google
4. Open **Developer Tools** (F12) → **Network** tab → Check **Preserve Log**
5. In the filter box, type `issueToken` and copy the full **Request URL**
6. In the filter box, type `oauth2/iframe`, click the last request, and copy the entire **Cookie** header value

⚠️ Do not log out of home.nest.com after copying credentials

data_description.issue_token: Paste the full Request URL from the issueToken network call, including all query parameters.
data_description.cookies: Paste the full Cookie header value from the oauth2/iframe request (include every key=value pair, even if it wraps onto multiple lines).

error.invalid_issue_token: Invalid issue token URL. Paste the full Request URL from the issueToken call, including query parameters.
error.invalid_cookies: Invalid cookie header. Paste the entire Cookie header from the oauth2/iframe request with all key=value pairs.
